findings.note: Composed 'No se pudo reproducir Vídeo generado.' / 'No se pudo mostrar Imagen generada 2.' read as a capitalised name with no article. That is acceptable for a label, but the fix lives in ui.chat.attachments.broken_* (e.g. quote {name}), not in this key. Output is the same as before the change; not gating.
'Vídeo' (accented, Peninsular) vs neutral-es 'video'; consistent with image_gen.state.* neighbours, so keep for consistency; any switch is catalogue-wide, out of scope.
